tool_schemas.name: search_models
tool_schemas.description: Searches the model catalog using a required free-text query (matched across model name, owner, tags, and description) and optional filters, returning a paged list of models ordered by the requested sort/order; pagination uses an opaque cursor and returns at most limit results. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if query is missing/empty, if any filter value is not in the allowed enums, if tags is not an array of strings, if limit is outside 1–100, or if cursor/IDs do not match the required patterns. Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if you request private/unlisted visibility or a restricted collection without access, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if your account is not permitted to perform additional search/list operations.

query.description: Free-text query to search across model name, owner, tags, and description.

collection_id.description: Filter results to models in a specific collection (collections.id).

tags.description: Filter to models that have all of the provided tags.

limit.description: Maximum number of models to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: list_models
tool_schemas.description: Lists models in the catalog with optional filtering by collection, visibility, type, status, owner, and tags, returning a paged result set sorted by the requested sort/order; pagination uses an opaque cursor and returns at most limit models. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any enum filter is invalid, IDs do not match required patterns, tags is not an array of strings, limit is outside 1–100, or cursor is malformed. Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR when filtering into private/unlisted models or collections you are not allowed to view, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when listing is rate/usage limited for your account.

collection_id.description: Filter results to models in a specific collection (collections.id).

tags.description: Filter to models that have all of the provided tags.

limit.description: Maximum number of models to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: list_collections
tool_schemas.description: Lists model collections, optionally filtered by status and sorted by the requested sort/order, returning a paged list with an opaque cursor and at most limit collections. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if status/sort/order is not one of the supported values, if limit is outside 1–100, or if cursor is malformed. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED if your account has exceeded allowed collection listing requests.

limit.description: Maximum number of collections to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get_collection
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single collection by collection_id and returns its metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if collection_id does not match the required pattern. Raises NOT_FOUND if no collection exists with that id, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the collection is not visible to your account.

tool_schemas.name: create_prediction
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new prediction run for the specified model (by model_version_id for versioned/community runs or by model_name with an optional vendor version string) and returns the created prediction record including its initial status and identifiers. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if input is missing, if both model_version_id and model_name are omitted, if IDs do not match required patterns, or if webhook_events_filter contains unsupported statuses or webhook_url is not a valid URL string. Raises NOT_FOUND if the referenced model version or model name/version cannot be resolved, AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if you are not allowed to run the requested model or visibility, QUOTA_EXCEEDED if you have insufficient quota to create additional predictions, and CONFLICT if the request attempts an unsupported model selection combination (for example providing identifiers that resolve to inconsistent targets).

model_version_id.description: Model version id to run (model_versions.id); typically used for community models.

model_name.description: Requested model identifier/name to run; typically used for official models.

version.description: Requested vendor version string for the model when using model_name (often a hash).

input.description: Model-specific input payload to pass to the prediction.

webhook_url.description: Optional webhook URL to receive prediction lifecycle events.

webhook_events_filter.description: Optional list of prediction statuses that should trigger webhook delivery.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_prediction
tool_schemas.description: Requests cancellation of a prediction and returns the updated prediction record reflecting the cancel request/state. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if prediction_id does not match the required pattern. Raises NOT_FOUND if the prediction does not exist, AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the prediction was created by a different client/account, and CONFLICT if the prediction is already in a terminal state (succeeded, failed, or canceled) and cannot be canceled.

tool_schemas.name: get_prediction
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single prediction by prediction_id and returns its current state, timestamps, and any available outputs. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if prediction_id does not match the required pattern. Raises NOT_FOUND if the prediction does not exist, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if you do not have access to that prediction (for example, it belongs to another client/account).

tool_schemas.name: list_predictions
tool_schemas.description: Lists predictions visible to your account with optional filtering by status, model_id, and model_version_id, returning a paged list sorted by created_at or updated_at; pagination uses an opaque cursor and returns at most limit predictions. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any enum is invalid, if IDs/cursor do not match required patterns, or if limit is outside 1–100. Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if you attempt to filter on resources you cannot access, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if your account has exceeded allowed prediction listing requests.

model_version_id.description: Filter predictions by model version id (model_versions.id).

limit.description: Maximum number of predictions to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get_model
tool_schemas.description: Returns metadata for a specific model by model_id and, when include_versions is true, includes a paged list of available model versions using versions_limit and versions_cursor. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if model_id does not match the required pattern, if include_versions is true and versions_limit is outside 1–100, or if versions_cursor is malformed. Raises NOT_FOUND if the model does not exist, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the model is not visible to your account (for example private/unlisted without access).

include_versions.description: Whether to include available versions for the model.

versions_limit.description: Maximum number of versions to include when include_versions is true.

versions_cursor.description: Pagination cursor for versions when include_versions is true.

tool_schemas.name: view_image
tool_schemas.description: Records an image-viewer cache entry for the provided URL (optionally associated to a prediction_id for traceability) and, when open_in_browser is true, opens the URL in the system default browser. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if url is not a valid URI, if prediction_id is provided but does not match the required pattern, or if open_in_browser is not a boolean. Raises NOT_FOUND if prediction_id is provided but no such prediction exists, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the referenced prediction is not accessible to your account.

url.description: Image URL to open in the system default browser (and cache locally).

prediction_id.description: Optional prediction id associated with this image view (for traceability).

open_in_browser.description: Whether to actually open the URL in the system default browser (if false, only cache/record it).

tool_schemas.name: clear_image_cache
tool_schemas.description: Clears image-viewer cache entries matching the requested mode and optional age filter, and returns a summary of how many entries would be or were removed (dry_run returns the would-be counts without deleting). Results are not paged because this endpoint does not list individual entries. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if mode is not one of all/evicted/error or older_than_days is provided and is < 1, and raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not allowed to manage local cache maintenance.

older_than_days.description: Only clear entries last viewed/downloaded earlier than this many days ago.

dry_run.description: If true, return what would be cleared without deleting anything.

tool_schemas.name: get_image_cache_stats
tool_schemas.description: Returns aggregate statistics for the image-viewer cache, and when include_by_status is true also returns counts grouped by cache entry status. Results are not paged because only summary totals are returned. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not allowed to view cache statistics, and raises VALIDATION_ERROR if include_by_status is not a boolean.

include_by_status.description: Whether to include counts grouped by cache entry status.

metadata.name: Replicate
